sloka: दक्षिणं मण्डलं चोभौ सुतूर्णं सम्परीयतुः।अन्योन्यमभिसङ्क्रुद्धौ जये प्रणिहितावुभौ ।। ६.९८.३२ ।।
transliteration: dakṣiṇaṁ maṇḍalaṁ cobhau sutūrṇaṁ samparīyatuḥ।anyonyamabhisaṅkruddhau jaye praṇihitāvubhau ।। 6.98.32 ।।

translations.english: Likewise, Sugriva endowed with speed, a champion of Vanaras, took up a huge sword fallen down with a shield.
